scripts.dev: npm run build -w @devmate/shared && npm run build -w @devmate/ai && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w @devmate/api" "npm run dev -w @devmate/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @devmate/shared && npm run build -w @devmate/ai && npm run build -w @devmate/api && npm run build -w @devmate/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @devmate/shared && npm run typecheck -w @devmate/ai && npm run typecheck -w @devmate/api && npm run typecheck -w @devmate/web
